input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (owner brief, prompts/ventures/prompt-2.md)
task: Deepen (flagship 7) photo-editing: Sony's vignetting table vs an evenly lit frame (third open item in next:)
errors: First run mislabelled maker-note 0x2011 value 2 as 'No correction params available'; ExifTool's table is 0 Off, 2 Auto. Fixed before any result was used.
First A7 III run rotated the embedded preview by EXIF Orientation; the preview is stored sensor-way-up, so alignment found 0 patches. Fixed and rerun.

doc_friction.issue: Says venture runs default to website requests then flagships, while the ventures brief says focus on revenue; the monetization next step waits on the owner (merchant link), so no revenue work was agent-doable. Cost a few minutes deciding.
Start-here row's 'take the third open item' needs counting items inside a 2000-char prose next:; items aren't numbered for photo-editing, so 'third' is a guess.

notes: No evenly lit Sony frame reachable (raw.pixls.us refused). Used the ARW's embedded camera JPEG (maker note vignetting=Auto) as the reference instead. Result: JPEG follows the distortion setting (A7 III 0.41 px with table vs 3.06 without; A7 IV 0.14 without vs 3.97 with) but shows no luminance lift from the 0x7032 table under any of four readings (shipped, squared as darktable v1, darktable knot positions, both). The question stays open; the table stays read-not-applied. Verification: tests/test_sony_vignetting_preview.py 6 passed; test_arw.py passes; three seeded faults caught; check_posts ok; validate.py ok; run_venture_tests photo-editing: ok, 1511 tests, 10 skipped, 225.7 s.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: imaging engineer: read darktable's Sony path, write and validate a JPEG-vs-raw gain estimator, run 3 files, write up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
